abstract: A 75-year-old man visited our hospital presenting with gross hematuria. Cystoscopy revealed a bladder tumor with coagulated blood and necrotic tissue at the dome. We resected the bladder tumor transurethrally. Pathologically, the tumor was shown to be a transitional cell carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation, G3, > or = pT2. Immunohistochemical staining showed human chorionic gonadotropin (HCG)-positive tumor cells. Just after surgery, the serum HCG-beta concentration was less than 0.1 ng/ml. Total cystectomy and an ileal conduit operation were performed. The histological classification was TCC, G3, pTis. In later blood chemistry tests, HCG-beta elevation was observed. Pulmonary metastases appeared on a chest X-ray, and combination chemotherapy with cisplatin and etoposide was administered. Although the serum HCG-beta decreased with one course of chemotherapy, it increased immediately thereafter. The patient died of the disease about 8 months after the total cystectomy. Autopsy revealed multiple metastases in the lungs, liver, kidneys, stomach, pancreas, thyroid gland, adrenal glands, heart, jejunum, and vertebral body (Th10). Lymph node metastases in the pulmonary hilum, mediastinum, and right submaxillary gland were also found.
abstract_ja: 75歳男性が肉眼的血尿を主訴に来院した。膀胱鏡検査で、膀胱ドーム部に凝血と壊死組織を伴う腫瘍を認めた。経尿道的に膀胱腫瘍を切除した。病理学的に、腫瘍は絨毛癌様分化を伴う移行上皮癌(G3、pT2以上)と診断された。免疫組織化学染色では、腫瘍細胞はヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性であった。術直後の血清hCG-β濃度は0.1 ng/ml未満であった。その後の血液生化学検査でhCG-βの上昇が認められた。胸部X線で肺転移が出現し、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる併用化学療法を施行した。1コースの化学療法で血清hCG-βは低下したが、その直後に再び上昇した。患者は膀胱全摘術および回腸導管造設術後約8か月で原病により死亡した。剖検では、肺、肝臓、腎臓、胃、膵臓、甲状腺、副腎、心臓、空腸、椎体(Th10)に多発転移が認められた。肺門部、縦隔および右顎下腺のリンパ節転移もみられた。
